comparison.objective: Raise an unpowered robot link to its zero mark and insert a calibration pin so it remains at zero after release.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual gravity-load support, visual/physical hole alignment, and transverse pin insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Pin is home, link remains within 1° of zero and still for one second, and both grippers are at least 30 mm clear; excessive link speed forces zero.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot setup and retained alignment, but this record aligns holes and inserts a load-bearing pin; it does not set a continuous stop with a screw, counterhold a jam nut, or verify repeated motion return.
